dispute_ticket.description: The app quoted S$22.90 but I was charged S$27.90. Nobody told me about ERP and the receipt screen showed the total twice for a few minutes. I did not pass any gantry and want S$5.00 back.

chat_logs.content: Arrived, black Mercedes at Exit A.

app_events.details: Upfront fare S$22.90 shown. Note: 'ERP and tolls are charged separately.' Surge 1.0x.
Rider R-7107 confirmed trip RYDE-DS-007 at S$22.90 plus ERP.
Gantry AYE-Pandan at 08:41:30: GPS crossing confirmed, gantry log rate S$2.00.
Gantry MCE-Marina at 08:53:10: GPS crossing confirmed, gantry log rate S$3.00.
Trip completed. Distance 17.4 km, 28 min. Route matched recommended route.
Final fare S$27.90 (fare S$22.90 + ERP S$5.00) charged to credit card.
Receipt screen displayed the total twice for about 2 minutes, then showed one entry. Only one charge was made.

erp_charged_to_rider_on_confirmed_gantry.text: Governs ERP tolls on this trip. A true value means a toll for a gantry crossing confirmed by GPS and the gantry log is charged to the rider in addition to the fare.

refund_at_ryde_discretion.text: Governs refunds on this trip. A true value means Ryde may refund beyond the strict rules where the facts justify it. It does not create a right to a refund.

surge_must_be_displayed_before_confirmat.text: Governs surge pricing. A true value means the surge must be shown to the rider before the booking is confirmed.

expected_outcome.reason: The app log shows two GPS-confirmed gantry crossings with gantry-log rates, AYE-Pandan S$2.00 at 08:41:30 and MCE-Marina S$3.00 at 08:53:10, and the GPS track passes both areas. The fare quote at 08:20 said ERP is charged separately and the rider confirmed on that basis. Under this trip's policy a confirmed crossing is charged on top of the fare, so S$22.90 + S$5.00 = S$27.90 stands. The duplicated receipt display was cosmetic; only one charge was made.
